parameters.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM customers
  WHERE customer_id = $1
    AND lower(security_answer) = lower(trim($2))
),
my_cards AS (
  SELECT card_id, card_type, last4, status
  FROM cards
  WHERE customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM c)
),
target AS (
  SELECT * FROM my_cards
  WHERE ($3 <> '' AND (last4 = $3 OR card_type = $3))
     OR ($3 = '' AND status = 'active'
         AND (SELECT count(*) FROM my_cards WHERE status = 'active') = 1)
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE cards k
  SET status = CASE WHEN $4 IN ('lost', 'stolen') THEN 'lost' ELSE 'blocked' END
  FROM target t
  WHERE k.card_id = t.card_id
    AND t.status = 'active'
    AND $5 = 'yes'
  RETURNING k.card_id, k.card_type, k.last4, k.status
),
logged AS (
  INSERT INTO card_actions (card_id, customer_id, action, reason)
  SELECT card_id, (SELECT customer_id FROM c), 'block', $4
  FROM updated
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT customer_id FROM c) AS customer_id,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('type', card_type, 'last4', last4, 'status', status)), '[]'::json) FROM my_cards) AS all_cards,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('type', card_type, 'last4', last4, 'status', status)), '[]'::json) FROM target) AS target_before,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('type', card_type, 'last4', last4, 'status', status)), '[]'::json) FROM updated) AS updated,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM logged) AS logged;
